blocks.text: After conquest, local powers such as those of Phagwara submit or are reorganized, and the Khalsa begins directing revenue and authority through a new order rather than simply plundering and moving on.
The page emphasizes that Mughal fiscal reach has weakened while Khalsa standards rise publicly across the region, with Baj Singh and Ram Singh linked to important administrative roles.
By naming Phagwara in this process, the page shows territorial consolidation rather than mere episodic victory.
